note: Allow-list of upstream hook formulas (ids from skills/ig-reel/hooks.json) that are safe for a faceless THIRD-PERSON news page. First-person formulas (1 Cost Confession, 6 The Receipt, 8 Insider Leak, 13 Before And After, 15 The Flop Record, 21 Mid-Sentence Start, 25 Someone Else's Result) are excluded because they would invent personal experience. 'prior' is the starting weight before analytics data exists.

formulas.name: The Statistic
formulas.example: India now handles 20 billion UPI payments in a single month.

formulas.name: The Reveal
formulas.template: This is the new {thing}, and it changes {one stake}.
formulas.example: This is the new RBI rule, and it changes how UPI limits work.

formulas.name: The Deadline
formulas.template: {Thing} changes on {real date}. Here is what to do before then.
formulas.example: UPI limits change on 1 September. Here is who is affected.

formulas.name: If This, Then Watch
formulas.template: If you {specific situation}, this {short time} matters.
formulas.example: If you pay shops with UPI, this change matters.

formulas.name: The Verbatim Question
formulas.example: Is your UPI payment about to cost money?

formulas.name: The Callout
formulas.template: {Specific group}: this is the update you have been waiting for.
formulas.example: Small shop owners: this payment change is for you.

formulas.name: Numbered With A Favourite
formulas.template: {N} things from {event}. Number {k} is the one that matters.
formulas.example: Three things from today's AI launch. Number two matters most.

formulas.name: Head To Head
formulas.template: {A} versus {B}: here is how they compare on the facts.
formulas.example: GPT versus Gemini: here is what the new numbers say.

formulas.name: The Superlative
formulas.example: The biggest AI deal this year is now official.

formulas.name: Nobody Tells You
formulas.template: Nobody is talking about {the catch in the news}.
formulas.example: Nobody is talking about the catch in this funding round.

formulas.name: The Replacement
formulas.example: This free tool now does what a paid one charged for.

formulas.name: Time Collapse
formulas.template: {Task} used to take {long time}. Now it takes {short time}.
formulas.example: Video editing used to take hours. This tool does it in minutes.
